steps.caption: Home
steps.narration: Google Profile is a shortcut in the menu that opens your business's Google profile page.

steps.caption: Open Google Business
steps.narration: In the menu on the left, open Google Business.

steps.caption: Google Profile
steps.narration: Google Profile is the first entry.

steps.caption: Choose it
steps.narration: Choose it. With one location, it opens that location straight away.

steps.caption: The Locations list
steps.narration: With several, as here, it opens the Locations list to pick from.

steps.caption: Scroll to the listing
steps.narration: Scroll to the listing you want.

steps.caption: The location page
steps.narration: The location opens on its Insights tab, with its other tabs down the side.

steps.caption: Menu: Locations
steps.narration: Inside Google Business, the same page is Locations in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to open your Google profile in one click | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: Where the Google Profile shortcut in ConstructHUB takes you. With one location it opens that location's page; with several it opens the Locations list, where Open profile takes you to the listing's Insights, details, services, photos and Profile Guard tabs.
